title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes management.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his type 2 diabetes. He reports feeling well and states that his energy levels are stable. He maintains a consistent routine and reports adherence to his current management strategy. He denies any acute symptoms or recent episodes of illness. He notes that he has no complications at this time.

Medication List
Diet and exercise only.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Skin is intact without lesions. Heart sounds are regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Extremities are well-perfused with normal strength and sensation.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus. The patient is currently stable and remains without complications. The condition is currently diet controlled.

Plan
Continue current lifestyle modifications. The patient will continue to focus on a healthy diet and regular physical activity. Follow up in three months for a repeat laboratory evaluation and clinical review.
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
